current_concerns.primary_problems: Well, it’s been kind of a dull patch… I’ve had less interest in things, more tired than I should be, and I’ve pulled back from people a bit. Sleep has been off too.
current_concerns.goals: I’d really like to enjoy life again, and stay active if I can.
